tldr_zh: Anthropic新模型Opus 5登頂AI排行榜，Meta暫停眼鏡付費功能，全球多國加強供應鏈安全防護
tldr_en: Anthropic's Opus 5 tops AI leaderboard; Meta pauses smart glasses paywall; global focus on supply chain security

items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 tops Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard
items.summary_zh: Anthropic發布新一代大語言模型Opus 5，在AI領域評估榜單上勤超群。根據Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard，Opus 5已成為排行榜首位。該版本強調在效率上的改進，特別是在降低token成本方面表現突出，雖然不是性能的重大飛躍，但展現出商業應用上的務實進步。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5, which now ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard. The model focuses on token efficiency and cost reduction rather than capability leap, representing practical improvements for commercial deployment.

items.title_zh: Meta因強烈反對暫停眼鏡付費限流計畫
items.title_en: Meta pauses smart glasses rate-limiting paywall plan after backlash
items.summary_zh: Meta計畫對Ray-Ban智能眼鏡的本地音訊功能收取每月20美元訂閱費遭到強烈反對後，宣布暫停此項計畫。該功能完全在眼鏡本地運行，無需雲端服務，Meta此舉引發廣泛批評。同時Meta眼鏡因被用於拍攝他人惡作劇和騷擾，已成為隱私和監控的焦點問題。
items.summary_en: Meta halted plans to charge $20/month for smart glasses audio features after public backlash. The feature runs locally and doesn't require cloud services. The glasses have also faced criticism for privacy concerns and harassment issues related to unauthorized filming.

items.title_zh: 高通宣布芯片漲價兩位數百分比幅度
items.title_en: Qualcomm raises prices by double digits on chip shipments after September
items.summary_zh: 高通周五向客户發送信函，宣布從9月1日起提高晶片價格，漲幅為兩位數百分比。高通聲稱已無法從供應商承受更高成本。此舉將對手機製造商、芯片設計公司和消費者造成連鎖影響。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm announced double-digit price increases effective September 1st, citing inability to absorb higher supplier costs. The move will impact smartphone manufacturers, chipmakers, and consumers globally.

items.title_zh: Roku提高串流設備價格最高漲幅50美元
items.title_en: Roku raises streaming hardware prices by up to $50 across product line
items.summary_zh: Roku對旗下所有串流設備提高價格，最便宜的HD Streaming Stick從29.99美元漲至39.99美元，部分設備漲幅高達50美元。Roku將漲價歸咎於記憶體短缺，雖然今年5月CEO曾稱芯片短缺對業務有利。
items.summary_en: Roku increased prices across its streaming hardware, with the cheapest model rising from $29.99 to $39.99, and some devices increasing by up to $50. The company attributes the hikes to RAM shortage despite CEO's earlier positive comments about chip supply.

items.title_zh: Bun創辦人用Claude AI重寫53萬行程式碼節省11天
items.title_en: Bun founder rewrites 530K lines of code from Zig to Rust in 11 days with Claude AI
items.summary_zh: JavaScript執行環境Bun的創辦人Jarred Sumner使用Anthropic的Claude Code AI助手，在11天內完成了原本需要3位資深工程師投入一年的53萬行程式碼重寫項目（從Zig轉換到Rust）。最終的Rust版本效能提升2%-5%，執行檔減小20%，並修復了128個舊版問題。
items.summary_en: Bun founder Jarred Sumner used Anthropic's Claude Code to rewrite 530K lines of code from Zig to Rust in just 11 days, replacing what would have taken 3 senior engineers a year. The Rust version showed 2-5% performance improvement and 20% smaller binary size.

items.title_zh: Midjourney收購佔星應用Co-Star進軍新領域
items.title_en: Midjourney acquires personalized astrology app Co-Star
items.summary_zh: AI圖像生成公司Midjourney宣布收購個人化佔星應用Co-Star。該應用提供每日運勢和個性化占星服務。此舉標誌Midjourney從圖像生成擴張到新應用領域的戰略。
items.summary_en: AI image generation company Midjourney acquired personalized astrology app Co-Star. The move expands Midjourney's portfolio beyond image generation into new applications.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出新AI鍵盤供編程人員使用
items.title_en: OpenAI launches new AI keypad for developers and coders
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布新AI鍵盤工具，為編程人員提供AI輔助功能。該工具對程式編寫工作者會很實用，但對其他用戶可能較難上手，體現了AI工具面向特定專業人群的發展趨勢。
items.summary_en: OpenAI released a new AI keypad designed for developers and coders. While useful for programming professionals, the tool may be less intuitive for general users.

items.title_zh: Google緊急發布Chrome 150修補4個高風險漏洞
items.title_en: Google emergency updates Chrome 150 patching four critical vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: Google本週發布Chrome 150版本更新，在兩天內緊急推出新版本針對Windows和macOS修補4個高風險安全漏洞。此舉顯示重要漏洞修補的緊迫性。
items.summary_en: Google released emergency updates for Chrome 150 within two days, patching four high-risk vulnerabilities affecting Windows and macOS.

items.title_zh: 美國警告伊朗駭客升級攻擊關鍵基礎設施
items.title_en: US warns Iranian hackers escalating attacks on critical infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 美國FBI和CISA於7月22日聯合發布警告，伊朗相關駭客組織正升級對可程式化邏輯控制器（PLC）的攻擊，目標包括施耐德電機和西門子等廠牌的工業控制設備，已導致部分機構營運中斷與財務損失。
items.summary_en: US FBI and CISA jointly warned that Iranian-linked hackers are escalating attacks on industrial control devices (PLCs) from major manufacturers including Schneider Electric and Siemens, causing operational disruptions and financial losses.

items.title_zh: 馬德里林火肆虐西班牙法國撤離14萬人
items.title_en: Madrid wildfire forces evacuation of 140,000 people across Spain and France
items.summary_zh: 西班牙馬德里地區面臨該地區「歷史上最嚴重的林火」，同時法國消防隊也在對付一場朝波爾多方向蔓延的火災。超過14萬人已在西班牙和法國進行撤離。
items.summary_en: Madrid wildfire described as 'worst in the region's history' forces evacuation of over 140,000 people across Spain and France. French firefighters battle a separate blaze approaching Bordeaux.

items.title_zh: 美國與伊朗在波斯灣交火衝突升溫
items.title_en: US and Iran trade strikes in Gulf as military tensions escalate
items.summary_zh: 美國與伊朗在波斯灣繼續交火，升級情勢。伊朗譴責美國計畫動用凍結的伊朗資產償還戰爭損害。雙方軍事衝突持續升溫，引發全球關注。
items.summary_en: US and Iran trade military strikes in the Gulf as escalation fears mount. Iran condemns US plan to use frozen Iranian assets to pay war damages amid ongoing tensions.

items.title_zh: 川普威脅對歐盟科技罰款啟動報復調查
items.title_en: Trump vows to investigate EU and reverse tech company fines
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普表示將對歐盟對Google、Apple、Meta和Amazon等美國科技公司的反托拉斯罰款進行調查，並聲稱這些罰款應「完全撤銷」，威脅祭出關稅報復。
items.summary_en: Trump pledges to investigate EU fines against US tech giants including Google, Apple, Meta, and Amazon, vowing the penalties should be 'entirely reversed' and threatening tariffs.
